title: WPSS/1556/2018 of Vijay Pal Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1556 of 2018
Vijay Pal Singh ... Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ...Respondents
Present: Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate for the petitioner
Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
 The Registry has pointed out a defect to the effect that the
order sought to be challenged by referring it to be an order dated
10.01.2018 in fact is not the order which has been annexed with the writ
petition. The learned counsel for the petitioner attempted to clarify the
said defect by taking this Court to Annexure 4 to the writ petition,
wherein the order dated 28.03.2018 by virtue of which the recovery has
been sought to be made against the petitioner, refers to be an order No.
266 dated 10.01.2018, as a matter of fact this in itself is not an order dated
10.01.2018 which has effected upon the recovery against the petitioner.
2. In that view of the matter, this Court finds that the defect as
raised by the Registry is required to be cured.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner on this prays for that he
may be permitted to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to file afresh
bringing the necessary and accurate facts and documents on record.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with
liberty to file fresh. However, there would be no order as to costs.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
15.06.2018
Mahinder/
